# Reference Manual parser fixtures

Hand-authored text in the *layout* the COMSOL Programming Reference
Manual uses after `pdftotext -layout` (feature heading, SYNTAX /
DESCRIPTION blocks, `TABLE x-y:` titles, fixed-width property tables,
wrapped cells, page footers). Feature and property **names, value
types and defaults are API facts**; every description is synthetic
("Fixture text for …") — none of COMSOL's documentation prose is
reproduced here. Do not paste manual text into these files; extend
them with invented rows in the same layout.
